item.text: I’m using the CafeCode image skill to create a lemon-pancake photograph, then embedding it directly in the HTML so the page remains one file.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "cat > /tmp/lemon-pancakes-prompt.txt <<'EOF'
An editorial food photograph for a refined home cooking blog. Close-up three-quarter overhead view of a small stack of four fluffy lemon ricotta pancakes, golden brown edges, soft creamy interiors, with a small dollop of ricotta on top and fine fresh yellow lemon zest, a delicate drizzle of honey. On a slightly irregular ivory ceramic plate on a pale warm beige linen tablecloth. A cut lemon and one whole lemon at the upper left edge, a simple silver fork at right, a casually folded pale linen napkin at lower right. Quiet natural morning window light from the left, soft realistic shadows, tactile food photography, subtle film grain, warm ivory and golden yellow with small muted olive green accents. The pancakes are appetizing and naturally imperfect. The plate is centered and fills most of the frame, captured at close range. Portrait 4:5 composition. No text, no lettering, no graphics, no watermarks, no berries, no flowers, no hands.
EOF
python3 /root/.agents/skills/cafecode-imagegen/scripts/generate_image.py --prompt-file /tmp/lemon-pancakes-prompt.txt --out /tmp/lemon-pancakes.png --size 1024x1280 --output-format png --dry-run"
